title: Compatibility of the specified proper-image successor transitions
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, finite-field datum D with l != D.p, schemes X,Y, morphism p:X->Y, Operations o, and integral derived input K. Put M=o.push(p)(calculus(X).reduction(K)). Let a_n be coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso at M followed by restricted direct-image evaluation and restricted direct image of reductionEvaluation at K. Then the successor transition of the restricted strict tower M, followed by a_n, equals a_(n+1) followed by sfDirectImageTransition(p,K,n). No properness, boundedness, completeness or geometric-base assumption is needed.

theorem integralProperTowerTransition (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (o : Operations l E) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y) (K : Integral l E X) :
    let M := (Operations.push l E o p).obj ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K)
    let a := fun n : ℕ ↦
      (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E Y n).app M ≪≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).mapIso
          (((o.evaluation p).evaluation n).app ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K) ≪≫
            (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage p
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).mapIso
                (((calculus l E X).reductionEvaluation n).app K))
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E Y D hl n.le_succ).app
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E Y).obj M) ≫ (a n).hom =
        (a (n + 1)).hom ≫ sfDirectImageTransition l E p K n
